tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /grags rgyal bla ma'i rnal 'byor bzhugs so// swa sti/ rje btsun grags pa la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum gyi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin che zhing mos pa skye sla ba rnams kyis gtso byas chos 'brel yod tshad kyi bla ma rnams dang / gzhan yang brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan mngon sum gsal bar bzhugs pa gyur/ zhes ngag tu brjod cing sems kyis kyang nges shes 'drongs par bsgom la/ /de la 'di phyi'i blo ltos ling gis bkal ba'i 'dun pa drag pos/ chos rnams kun gyis de nyid gzigs/ /zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig pu de/ brgya rtsa stong rtsa sogs ci nus gsol ba btab/ thun bsdu ba ni/ mdun gyi rje btsun rang la thim nas byin gyis brlab par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam la mos gus yid la byed pa'i tshul gyi sems cung zad mnyam par bzhag smon lam gdab pa ni/ mthong zhing thos sam rjes su dran yang rung / /reg gam gtam du brjod pa tsam gyis kyang / /rnam pa kun tu 'gro la phan pa ni/ /bde dang ldan pa rtag tu byed gyur cig /ces sogs bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa sogs brjod/ dus thams cad du chos mthun gyi bya bas gnas par bya'o/ /zhes pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bla ma dam pa dran pa'i sgo nas bris/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 klu sgrub/ grags rgyal bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
